source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板 (src/world/megaton.js) の改修用。画像が無いあいだは既存の素材に色を付けて代用している。自分で作った 3x3 の画像を assets/textures/sheets/<id>.webp に置くか、texgen.py generate で生成する
style: Residential corridor surfaces for different neighbourhoods of a bright space-habitat city. Flat, evenly lit, front-on or top-down, no perspective, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-floor-old
cells.prompt: Old-town alley floor from above: worn light grey diamond-tread steel plates with welded patch repairs and polished walking paths.

cells.name: mg-wall-old
cells.prompt: Old-town alley wall: cream steel wall plates painted over many times, rivet rows, patched holes, faded hand-painted marks.

cells.name: mg-floor-danchi
cells.prompt: Apartment-block corridor floor from above: pale green non-slip vinyl with small embossed dots and faint scuffs.

cells.name: mg-wall-danchi
cells.prompt: Apartment-block corridor wall: white painted concrete with very fine texture and slight unevenness.

cells.name: mg-floor-view
cells.prompt: Upscale residential corridor floor from above: light warm marble-look tiles with soft grey veins.

cells.name: mg-wall-view
cells.prompt: Upscale corridor wall: vertical light oak slat panels with narrow dark gaps between slats.

cells.name: mg-floor-ninth
cells.prompt: New district floor from above: white terrazzo with small grey and pale blue chips.

cells.name: mg-wall-ninth
cells.prompt: New district wall: white composite panels with rounded corners and slim recessed joints.

cells.name: mg-floor-hikari
cells.prompt: New apartment estate corridor floor from above: blue-grey vinyl sheet with a subtle speckle.
